title: Prospector: learning a compact graph traversal policy for scientific reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2610.37121v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Scientific reasoning in specialized engineering fields depends on knowledge scattered across the literature, often proprietary and absent from frontier LLM training data. In such domains, frontier models tend to give generic answers. Knowledge graphs (KGs) can ground LLM reasoning. Because a graph is too large to provide in full, typical LLM+KG systems preselect a portion, deciding relevance before reasoning begins. Here we train a compact model, Prospector, to reason over a domain knowledge graph by traversing it step by step, seeking evidence in light of what it has already found. Prospector calls a small set of tools one at a time to progressively build its context, and answers with a chain of evidence that can be checked edge by edge against what its tools retrieved from the graph. On a knowledge graph built from the semiconductor-manufacturing literature, Prospector approaches the strongest off-the-shelf models given the same graph

translated_title: Prospector：学习一种用于科学推理的紧凑图遍历策略
translated_abstract: 专业工程领域的科学推理依赖于散布在文献中的知识，这些知识往往是专有的，且不在前沿大语言模型的训练数据中。在这类领域，前沿模型往往只能给出泛泛的回答。知识图谱（KG）可以为大语言模型的推理提供依据。由于图谱规模过大而无法完整提供，典型的LLM+KG系统会预先选取一部分内容，即在推理开始之前就判断相关性。本文训练了一个紧凑的模型Prospector，通过逐步遍历领域知识图谱进行推理，根据已经找到的线索去寻找证据。Prospector每次调用一个小型工具集来逐步构建其上下文，并以一条证据链的形式给出答案，该证据链可以逐边对照其工具从图谱中检索到的内容进行验证。在一个由半导体制造文献构建的知识图谱上，在给定相同图谱的情况下，Prospector的性能接近最强的现成模型。
tldr: Prospector是一个紧凑模型，通过逐步遍历领域知识图谱收集证据并构建可逐边验证的证据链，在半导体制造知识图谱上以小模型性能接近最强的现成大模型。
en_tdlr: Prospector is a compact model that traverses a domain knowledge graph step by step to gather evidence and build verifiable evidence chains, approaching the performance of the strongest off-the-shelf LLMs on a semiconductor-manufacturing knowledge graph.
